scope: phase1 Chinese source expansion; no phase2
split_policy: Inherit existing canonical source conversation splits; preserve old artifacts, no reassignments. New ECD contexts use frozen conversation_split seed42, 30%/70%.

dulemon.references: Use user_said_persona=keep and user_no_said_persona=discard directly; noisy native references require owner audit. Models compare references, never filter them.
dulemon.negative_conversation_policy: No-said personas do not make the whole conversation negative. Assistant-only derivatives excluded from original-negative-conversation counts.

perltqa.license: CC BY-NC 4.0; noncommercial; attribute authors and modifications

ecd.sample_unit: Unique positive-response context from train; reservoir seed42, not response-ranking negatives
ecd.candidate_method: All original utterances, no model prefilter or rewrite
ecd.speaker_policy: Unknown source roles stay unknown; do not infer user/assistant by parity
ecd.license: Unknown; source and review text stay local; public reports contain metadata/methods/metrics only
